source.text: וְהָ֣אָדָ֔ם יָדַ֖ע אֶת־חַוָּ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וַתַּ֨הַר֙ וַתֵּ֣לֶד אֶת־קַ֔יִן וַתֹּ֕אמֶר קָנִ֥יתִי אִ֖ישׁ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the man knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bore Cain, and she said, I have gotten a man with YHWH.

en.L: And the man knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bore Cain, and she said, "I have gotten a man with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: The man was intimate with his wife Eve, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Cain. She said, "With the help of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I have brought a man into being."
en.R: The man and his wife Eve had a child together. She became pregnant and gave birth to a son named Cain. She said, "With {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s help, I have had a baby boy."

es.L: Y el hombre conoció a Eva su mujer, y ella concibió y dio a luz a Caín, y dijo: «He adquirido un varón con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.B: El hombre se unió a su esposa Eva, y ella quedó embarazada y dio a luz a Caín. Entonces dijo: «Con la ayuda {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} he dado vida a un hombre».
es.R: El hombre y su esposa Eva tuvieron relaciones, y ella quedó embarazada. Dio a luz a un hijo llamado Caín, y dijo: «Con la ayuda {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} he tenido un hijo varón».

fr.L: Et l’homme connut Ève, sa femme ; elle conçut et enfanta Caïn, et elle dit : « J’ai acquis un homme avec {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: L’homme s’unit à Ève, sa femme ; elle devint enceinte et donna naissance à Caïn. Elle dit : « Avec l’aide {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, j’ai donné la vie à un homme. »
fr.R: L’homme et sa femme Ève ont eu un enfant. Elle est tombée enceinte et elle a mis au monde un fils, appelé Caïn. Elle a dit : « Avec l’aide {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, j’ai eu un petit garçon. »

sw.L: Na yule mtu akamjua Hawa mkewe, naye akapata mimba, akamzaa Kaini, akasema, "Nimempata mwanamume pamoja na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Yule mtu alikutana kimwili na mkewe Hawa, naye akapata mimba, akamzaa Kaini. Akasema, "Kwa msaada wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nimempata mwanamume."
sw.R: Yule mtu na mkewe Hawa walipata mtoto. Hawa alipata mimba, akamzaa mtoto wa kiume, akamwita Kaini. Akasema, "Kwa msaada wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nimepata mtoto wa kiume."

vi.L: Và con người ăn ở với Ê-va vợ mình, và nàng thụ thai và sinh Ca-in, và nàng nói: "Tôi đã có được một người nam với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.B: Con người ăn ở với Ê-va vợ mình, và nàng mang thai rồi sinh Ca-in. Nàng nói: "Nhờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ, tôi đã sinh được một người nam."
vi.R: Người đàn ông và vợ mình là Ê-va có con với nhau. Nàng mang thai và sinh một con trai tên là Ca-in. Nàng nói: "Nhờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ, tôi đã có được một bé trai."

ko.L: 그리고 그 사람이 자기 아내 하와를 알았다. 그러자 그 여자가 임신하여 가인을 낳고 말했다. "내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 함께 한 남자를 얻었다."
ko.B: 그 사람이 자기 아내 하와와 동침하니, 하와가 임신하여 가인을 낳았다. 하와가 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 도우심으로 내가 한 남자를 얻었다."
ko.R: 그 사람과 그의 아내 하와 사이에 아이가 생겼다. 하와는 임신하여 가인이라는 아들을 낳았다. 하와가 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 도와주셔서 내가 아들을 얻었다."

pt.L: E o homem conheceu Eva, a sua mulher, e ela concebeu e deu à luz Caim, e disse: "Obtive um homem com {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."
pt.B: O homem teve relações com Eva, a sua mulher, e ela ficou grávida e deu à luz Caim. Ela disse: "Com a ajuda {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, eu trouxe ao mundo um homem."
pt.R: O homem e a sua esposa Eva tiveram um filho. Ela ficou grávida e deu à luz um menino chamado Caim. Ela disse: "Com a ajuda {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, tive um menino."

am.L: ሰውም ሚስቱን ሔዋንን አወቃት፤ ፀነሰችም፤ ቃየንንም ወለደች፤ አለችም፦ «{{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ጋር ወንድ አገኘሁ።»
am.B: ሰው ከሚስቱ ከሔዋን ጋር ተኛ፤ እርሷም ፀንሳ ቃየንን ወለደች። «{{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} እርዳታ ሰውን አስገኘሁ» አለች።
am.R: ሰውየውና ሚስቱ ሔዋን ልጅ አገኙ። እርሷም ፀንሳ ቃየን የተባለ ወንድ ልጅ ወለደች። «{{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} እርዳታ ወንድ ልጅ አገኘሁ» አለች።

decisions.choice: knew: had sexual relations with
decisions.reason: "Know" is a Hebrew way of speaking of sexual union (4:17, 25; 1 Samuel 1:19). It is a personal word, not a crude one.

decisions.choice: Cain ... I have gotten: the name sounds like the verb
decisions.reason: Eve explains the name Cain (qayin) by the verb she uses, "I have gotten" or "I have made" (qaniti). The verb can mean to acquire and also to create (Proverbs 8:22; Deuteronomy 32:6).

decisions.choice: a man with the LORD: with the LORD's help
alternatives: a man, as the LORD did
decisions.reason: The small word "with" (et) can also mark an object, and some have read "I have gotten a man: the LORD", as if Eve thought her son was the promised one of 3:15. But "with" is its usual sense in such a phrase, and the ancient translations read it as help from God. Eve speaks of her son as "a man", a proud word for a newborn, and she names the LORD as the giver of life.

decisions.choice: was intimate with (B); had a child together (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom "knew" (m1); Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}
decisions.reason: The divine name is "el SEÑOR" by default, in small capitals as in English, with "Yahvé" as a reader setting. The span takes in the article and any contraction ("del SEÑOR" / "de Yahvé", "al SEÑOR" / "a Yahvé"), since "Yahvé" takes no article. "Jehová" is a later hybrid form; plain "el Señor" would not show that the name is used.

decisions.choice: un varón (L); un hijo varón (R)
decisions.reason: Eve calls her newborn son "a man" (meaning decision m3). Literal says "varón", the word for a male person, which keeps the wording unusual as it is in Hebrew; Balanced says "un hombre"; Readable "un hijo varón".

decisions.choice: passé simple (L, B); passé composé (R)
decisions.reason: French narrative tense by level, as the French style guide sets it: the passé simple, the tense of written narrative, at Literal and Balanced ("connut", "donna naissance"), the passé composé of spoken French at Readable ("a mis au monde"). Speech keeps the tenses of speech at every level ("j'ai acquis").

decisions.choice: "ăn ở với" (L, B), "có con với nhau" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "knew" means had sexual relations with (m1); Vietnamese "biết" does not carry that sense, so every level says it in a Vietnamese way, Literal with the discreet "ăn ở với". The same wording is kept in 4:17 and 4:25.

decisions.choice: "알았다" (L); "동침하니" (B); "사이에 아이가 생겼다" (R)
decisions.reason: "Knew" is the Hebrew way of speaking of the bond of husband and wife (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps the Hebrew verb, which Korean readers of the Bible know in this sense; Balanced uses the usual decent word; Readable speaks of the child, as the English Readable does. The same words return in 4:17 and 4:25.

decisions.choice: Obtive
decisions.reason: Eve explains the name Caim by the verb she uses (m2); Portuguese has no verb that sounds like the name, so the play is lost and the meaning note explains it. Literal says "obtive", which keeps both senses of the verb, to get and to bring about.

decisions.choice: "አወቃት" (knew her) at Literal; "ከሚስቱ ጋር ተኛ" (lay with his wife) at Balanced; "ልጅ አገኙ" (had a child) at Readable; "አገኘሁ" (I have gotten) for Eve's word, without the wordplay on Cain's name
decisions.reason: "Knew" means sexual relations (meaning decision m1). Amharic can say "አወቃት" in the same sense, and Literal keeps it; Balanced uses the plain, decent "lay with", and Readable says what followed, as the English Readable does. The name Cain sounds like the Hebrew verb "I have gotten" (m2); the Amharic "ቃየን" and "አገኘሁ" cannot echo each other, so only the sense is kept.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic in this passage: pronouns and verbs for God are written once
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the reader's setting for capitalised pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic (see 1:1).

source.text: וַתֹּ֣סֶף לָלֶ֔דֶת אֶת־אָחִ֖יו אֶת־הָ֑בֶל וַֽיְהִי־הֶ֨בֶל֙ רֹ֣עֵה צֹ֔אן וְקַ֕יִן הָיָ֖ה עֹבֵ֥ד אֲדָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And she added to bear his brother, Abel. And Abel was a shepherd of flock, and Cain was a worker of ground.

en.L: And again she bore his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, and Cain was a worker of the ground.
en.B: Later she gave birth to his brother Abel. Abel kept flocks of sheep and goats, and Cain worked the ground.
en.R: Later she had another son, Abel. Abel took care of sheep and goats, and Cain was a farmer.

es.L: Y volvió a dar a luz a su hermano Abel. Y Abel era pastor de ovejas, y Caín era trabajador de la tierra.
es.B: Después dio a luz a Abel, su hermano. Abel cuidaba rebaños de ovejas y cabras, y Caín cultivaba la tierra.
es.R: Más tarde tuvo otro hijo, Abel. Abel cuidaba ovejas y cabras, y Caín era agricultor.

fr.L: Et elle enfanta encore son frère, Abel. Et Abel était berger de moutons, et Caïn était travailleur du sol.
fr.B: Elle donna ensuite naissance à Abel, son frère. Abel gardait des troupeaux de moutons et de chèvres, et Caïn cultivait le sol.
fr.R: Plus tard, elle a eu un autre fils, Abel. Abel s’occupait des moutons et des chèvres, et Caïn était agriculteur.

sw.L: Akamzaa tena nduguye Habili. Naye Habili alikuwa mchungaji wa kondoo, na Kaini alikuwa mkulima wa ardhi.
sw.B: Baadaye akamzaa Habili, ndugu yake. Habili alichunga makundi ya kondoo na mbuzi, na Kaini alilima ardhi.
sw.R: Baadaye Hawa alimzaa mtoto mwingine, Habili. Habili alichunga kondoo na mbuzi, na Kaini alikuwa mkulima.

vi.L: Và nàng lại sinh em của nó là A-bên. Và A-bên là người chăn chiên, và Ca-in là người cày cấy đất.
vi.B: Sau đó nàng sinh em của Ca-in là A-bên. A-bên chăn bầy chiên dê, còn Ca-in cày cấy đất.
vi.R: Sau đó nàng sinh thêm một con trai nữa là A-bên. A-bên chăn chiên và dê, còn Ca-in làm ruộng.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자가 다시 그의 동생 아벨을 낳았다. 그리고 아벨은 양을 치는 사람이 되었고, 가인은 땅을 일구는 사람이 되었다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 하와는 가인의 동생 아벨을 낳았다. 아벨은 양과 염소 떼를 쳤고, 가인은 땅을 일구었다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 하와는 또 아들 아벨을 낳았다. 아벨은 양과 염소를 돌보았고, 가인은 농사를 지었다.

pt.L: E de novo ela deu à luz o irmão dele, Abel. E Abel era pastor de rebanho, e Caim era trabalhador do solo.
pt.B: Depois ela deu à luz o irmão dele, Abel. Abel cuidava de rebanhos de ovelhas e cabras, e Caim cultivava o solo.
pt.R: Mais tarde ela teve outro filho, Abel. Abel cuidava de ovelhas e cabras, e Caim era agricultor.

am.L: ደግሞም ወንድሙን አቤልን ወለደች። አቤልም የመንጋ እረኛ ነበረ፤ ቃየንም መሬትን የሚሠራ ነበረ።
am.B: ከዚያም ወንድሙን አቤልን ወለደች። አቤል የበጎችና የፍየሎች መንጋ ጠባቂ ነበረ፤ ቃየንም መሬትን ያርስ ነበር።
am.R: ከዚያ በኋላ አቤል የተባለ ሌላ ወንድ ልጅ ወለደች። አቤል በጎችንና ፍየሎችን ይጠብቅ ነበር፤ ቃየን ደግሞ ገበሬ ነበር።

decisions.choice: Abel (Hevel): a name that means "breath"
decisions.reason: The name is the word for breath or vapor, something that does not last; Ecclesiastes uses it for what is fleeting (Ecclesiastes 1:2). The story gives no explanation of the name, but Abel's life is short.

decisions.choice: keeper of the flock, worker of the ground: the two main ways of life
decisions.reason: The brothers take up the two callings of the ancient world: herding animals and farming. Cain's work is the man's work of 2:15 and 3:23. The text does not favor one way of life over the other.

decisions.choice: flock: sheep and goats together
decisions.reason: The word covers small livestock, both sheep and goats.

decisions.choice: again she bore
decisions.reason: Hebrew says "she added to bear", a common way of saying "she did it again".

decisions.choice: "동생" for "his brother"
decisions.reason: Korean names a brother as older or younger. Abel is born after Cain, so he is "동생" here and in verses 8-11. Where the Hebrew does not show who is older (Jubal, verse 21), Korean says "형제".

source.text: וַֽיְהִ֖י מִקֵּ֣ץ יָמִ֑ים וַיָּבֵ֨א קַ֜יִן מִפְּרִ֧י הָֽאֲדָמָ֛ה מִנְחָ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was from [the] end of days, and brought Cain from [the] fruit of the ground an offering to YHWH.

en.L: And it happened at the end of days that Cain brought some of the fruit of the ground as an offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: In the course of time Cain brought some of the produce of the ground as an offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: After some time, Cain brought some of his crops as a gift to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y sucedió al cabo de los días que Caín trajo del fruto de la tierra una ofrenda {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Con el paso del tiempo, Caín llevó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} una ofrenda de los productos de la tierra.
es.R: Pasado un tiempo, Caín le llevó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} parte de su cosecha como regalo.

fr.L: Et il arriva, au bout des jours, que Caïn apporta du fruit du sol en offrande {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Avec le temps, Caïn apporta des produits du sol en offrande {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Quelque temps après, Caïn a apporté une partie de ses récoltes {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, comme cadeau.

sw.L: Ikawa mwisho wa siku, Kaini akaleta baadhi ya matunda ya ardhi kuwa sadaka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Baada ya muda, Kaini alileta baadhi ya mazao ya ardhi kuwa sadaka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Baada ya muda fulani, Kaini alimletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} baadhi ya mazao yake kama zawadi.

vi.L: Và vào cuối những ngày ấy, Ca-in đem một ít hoa quả của đất làm lễ vật dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Một thời gian sau, Ca-in đem một ít hoa lợi của đất làm lễ vật dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Sau một thời gian, Ca-in đem một ít hoa màu của mình làm quà dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 날들의 끝에 가인이 땅의 열매 가운데서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 예물을 가져왔다.
ko.B: 얼마 뒤에 가인은 땅에서 거둔 것 가운데 얼마를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 예물로 가져왔다.
ko.R: 얼마가 지난 뒤에, 가인은 자기가 거둔 곡식 가운데 얼마를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 예물로 가져왔다.

pt.L: E aconteceu, passados [alguns] dias, que Caim trouxe do fruto do solo uma oferta {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.B: Com o passar do tempo, Caim trouxe parte do produto do solo como oferta {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.R: Algum tempo depois, Caim trouxe uma parte da sua colheita como presente {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

am.L: በቀናትም መጨረሻ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ቃየን ከመሬት ፍሬ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} መባ አመጣ።
am.B: ከጊዜ በኋላ ቃየን ከመሬት ፍሬ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} መባ አድርጎ አመጣ።
am.R: ከተወሰነ ጊዜ በኋላ ቃየን ከሰብሉ ጥቂቱን {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስጦታ አድርጎ አመጣ።

decisions.choice: at the end of days: after some time
alternatives: at the end of the year
decisions.reason: The phrase usually means after a period of time, perhaps at the end of a season or a year, when crops were gathered.

decisions.choice: offering: a gift brought to God
alternatives: grain offering (in its later sense only)
decisions.reason: The word means a gift, and it is used for tribute to a king (32:13) as well as for gifts to God. In the laws of Leviticus it names the grain offering; here it is used of both brothers' gifts, plants and animals alike.

decisions.choice: passados [alguns] dias
decisions.reason: Portuguese cannot say "at the end of days" without an article, and "ao fim dos dias" would sound like the end of time; Literal says "passados [alguns] dias", with the word Portuguese needs in brackets (m1).

decisions.choice: "መባ" (offering, gift to God) at Literal and Balanced; "ስጦታ" (gift) at Readable, in 4:3-5
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is a gift brought to God (meaning decision m2); in Leviticus it becomes the name of the grain offering, but here both brothers bring one, of crops and of animals. "መባ" is the general word for what is brought to God, and "መሥዋዕት" would make it a slaughtered sacrifice.

source.text: וְהֶ֨בֶל הֵבִ֥יא גַם־ה֛וּא מִבְּכֹר֥וֹת צֹאנ֖וֹ וּמֵֽחֶלְבֵהֶ֑ן וַיִּ֣שַׁע יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־הֶ֖בֶל וְאֶל־מִנְחָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And Abel brought, also he, from [the] firstborn of his flock and from their fat [portions]. And looked YHWH to Abel and to his offering,

en.L: And Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of their fat portions. And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} looked with favor on Abel and on his offering,
en.B: And Abel also brought an offering: some of the firstborn of his flock, with their fat portions. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} looked with favor on Abel and his offering,
en.R: Abel also brought a gift. He chose some of the first lambs born in his flock and offered their best parts. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was pleased with Abel and his gift,

es.L: Y Abel trajo también él de los primogénitos de su rebaño, y de la grasa de ellos. Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} miró con agrado a Abel y a su ofrenda,
es.B: También Abel llevó una ofrenda: algunas de las primeras crías de su rebaño, con su grasa. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} miró con agrado a Abel y su ofrenda,
es.R: Abel también llevó un regalo. Escogió algunos de los primeros corderos que nacieron en su rebaño y ofreció las mejores partes. {{divine_name:Al SEÑOR|A Yahvé}} le agradaron Abel y su regalo,

fr.L: Et Abel, lui aussi, apporta des premiers-nés de son troupeau et de leur graisse. Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} porta un regard favorable sur Abel et sur son offrande,
fr.B: Abel, lui aussi, apporta une offrande : quelques-uns des premiers-nés de son troupeau, avec leurs parties grasses. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} accueillit avec faveur Abel et son offrande,
fr.R: Abel aussi a apporté un cadeau. Il a choisi quelques-uns des premiers agneaux nés dans son troupeau, et il en a offert les meilleurs morceaux. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a été content d’Abel et de son cadeau,

sw.L: Naye Habili pia akaleta baadhi ya wazaliwa wa kwanza wa kundi lake na baadhi ya mafuta yao. Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamtazama kwa kibali Habili na sadaka yake,
sw.B: Habili naye alileta sadaka: baadhi ya wazaliwa wa kwanza wa kundi lake, pamoja na sehemu zao za mafuta. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamkubali Habili na sadaka yake,
sw.R: Habili pia alileta zawadi. Alichagua baadhi ya wana-kondoo wa kwanza waliozaliwa katika kundi lake, akatoa sehemu zao zilizo bora. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipendezwa na Habili na zawadi yake,

vi.L: Và A-bên, chính ông cũng đem một ít con đầu lòng của bầy mình và mỡ của chúng. Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đoái nhìn A-bên và lễ vật của ông,
vi.B: A-bên cũng đem dâng lễ vật: một ít con đầu lòng trong bầy mình, cùng với mỡ của chúng. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đoái nhìn A-bên và lễ vật của ông,
vi.R: A-bên cũng đem dâng một món quà. Ông chọn một ít chiên con đầu lòng trong bầy mình và dâng những phần tốt nhất của chúng. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hài lòng về A-bên và món quà của ông,

ko.L: 그리고 아벨도 자기 양 떼의 맏배와 그것들의 기름에서 가져왔다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 아벨과 그의 예물을 좋게 보셨으나,
ko.B: 아벨도 예물을 가져왔다. 자기 양 떼에서 처음 난 것들과 그 기름진 부분이었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 아벨과 그의 예물을 반기셨으나,
ko.R: 아벨도 예물을 가져왔다. 아벨은 자기 양 떼에서 처음 태어난 새끼들 가운데 몇 마리를 골라, 그 가장 좋은 부분을 바쳤다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 아벨과 그의 예물을 기쁘게 받으셨지만,

pt.L: E Abel trouxe, também ele, dos primogênitos do seu rebanho e da gordura deles. E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} olhou com favor para Abel e para a sua oferta,
pt.B: E Abel também trouxe uma oferta: alguns dos primogênitos do seu rebanho, com as suas partes de gordura. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} olhou com favor para Abel e para a sua oferta,
pt.R: Abel também trouxe um presente. Ele escolheu alguns dos primeiros cordeiros que nasceram no seu rebanho e ofereceu as melhores partes deles. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ficou contente com Abel e com o presente dele,

am.L: አቤልም ደግሞ ከመንጋው በኩሮችና ከስባቸው አመጣ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ወደ አቤልና ወደ መባው በሞገስ ተመለከተ፣
am.B: አቤልም ደግሞ መባ አመጣ፤ ከመንጋው በኩሮች ጥቂቶቹን ከስባቸው ጋር አቀረበ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አቤልንና መባውን በሞገስ ተመለከተ፣

decisions.choice: the firstborn of his flock and their fat: the first and the best
decisions.reason: The firstborn of the flock and the fat portions were counted as the best and as belonging to God (Exodus 13:12; Leviticus 3:16). Abel's gift is described with care; Cain's simply as "some of the fruit" (verse 3), not the first fruits.

decisions.choice: looked with favor: accepted
decisions.reason: The verb means to look at, here with favor. The story does not say how Cain and Abel knew which offering was accepted.

decisions.choice: their best parts
decisions.reason: Readable says what the fat portions stood for (m1): the best of the animal.

decisions.choice: las primeras crías de su rebaño
decisions.reason: In modern Spanish "primogénito" is used mainly of people. Literal keeps it, the word of the laws on the firstborn (meaning decision m1); Balanced says what it means for a flock.

decisions.choice: "ông" for Abel and Cain as grown men in the narrative
decisions.reason: The narrative refers to grown men as "ông" (he), as the Vietnamese of Hebrews 11:4 does for Abel; "nó" in 4:2 L is the child just born.

en.R: but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was not pleased with Cain and his gift. Cain became very angry, and he looked upset.

ko.L: 가인과 그의 예물은 좋게 보지 않으셨다. 그래서 가인은 몹시 화가 났고, 그의 얼굴이 떨어졌다.

ko.R: 가인과 그의 예물은 기뻐하지 않으셨다. 가인은 몹시 화가 났고, 얼굴이 일그러졌다.

pt.B: mas para Caim e a sua oferta {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não olhou com favor. Por isso Caim ficou muito irado, e o seu rosto se fechou.

am.L: ወደ ቃየንና ወደ መባው ግን በሞገስ አልተመለከተም። ቃየንም እጅግ ተቆጣ፤ ፊቱም ወደቀ።

am.R: በቃየንና በስጦታው ግን ደስ አልተሰኘም። ቃየን በጣም ተናደደ፤ ተበሳጨም።

decisions.choice: Cain's offering not accepted: the reason is not stated
alternatives: because grain was the wrong kind of offering
because Cain's heart was not right
decisions.reason: The text does not say why. It describes Abel's gift as the first and best (verse 4) and Cain's more plainly, and it says God looked on Abel and Cain themselves as well as on their gifts. Hebrews 11:4 says Abel offered "by faith", and 1 John 3:12 that Cain's own deeds were evil. Grain offerings were acceptable in Israel's law, so the kind of gift is not likely the reason.

decisions.choice: it burned to Cain: Cain was furious
decisions.reason: Anger is described as burning in Hebrew. "His face fell" pictures sullen anger or dejection.

decisions.choice: o seu rosto se fechou (B); fechou a cara (R)
decisions.reason: Portuguese pictures sullen anger as a face that closes, which is what "his face fell" means here (m2); "descair o semblante" is the wording of older Bibles. Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, "o rosto dele caiu".

decisions.choice: "ፊቱ ወደቀ" (his face fell) at Literal; "ፊቱ ጠቆረ" (his face darkened) at Balanced; "ተበሳጨ" (he was upset) at Readable, and in verse 6
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture. Amharic says a face "darkens" with anger or gloom, so Balanced uses that idiom, and Readable says plainly how Cain felt.

pt.B: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Caim: "Por que estás irado? Por que o teu rosto está fechado?

decisions.choice: why ...? why ...?: God speaks to Cain before he acts
decisions.reason: As with the man and woman in chapter 3, God speaks with Cain by asking questions. This time he speaks before the wrong is done, to warn him (verse 7).
