records.literal_gloss: And knew Adam again his wife, and she bore a son and called his name Seth, for has appointed to me God another offspring in place of Abel, for Cain killed him.

en.L: And Adam knew his wife again, and she bore a son and called his name Seth, "For God has appointed for me another offspring in place of Abel, because Cain killed him."
en.B: Adam was intimate with his wife again, and she gave birth to a son and named him Seth, saying, "God has given me another child in place of Abel, since Cain killed him."
en.R: Adam and his wife had another son. She named him Seth. She said, "God has given me another child to take the place of Abel, because Cain killed him."

es.L: Y conoció Adán otra vez a su mujer, y ella dio a luz un hijo y llamó su nombre Set: «Porque Dios me ha puesto otra descendencia en lugar de Abel, pues Caín lo mató».
es.B: Adán se unió de nuevo a su esposa, y ella dio a luz un hijo al que llamó Set, diciendo: «Dios me ha dado otro hijo en lugar de Abel, ya que Caín lo mató».
es.R: Adán y su esposa tuvieron otro hijo. Ella lo llamó Set, y dijo: «Dios me ha dado otro hijo que ocupe el lugar de Abel, porque Caín lo mató».

fr.L: Et Adam connut encore sa femme ; elle enfanta un fils et appela son nom Seth : « Car Dieu m’a établi une autre descendance à la place d’Abel, parce que Caïn l’a tué. »
fr.B: Adam s’unit de nouveau à sa femme ; elle donna naissance à un fils et l’appela Seth, en disant : « Dieu m’a accordé un autre enfant à la place d’Abel, puisque Caïn l’a tué. »
fr.R: Adam et sa femme ont eu un autre fils. Elle l’a appelé Seth. Elle a dit : « Dieu m’a donné un autre enfant pour remplacer Abel, parce que Caïn l’a tué. »

sw.L: Naye Adamu akamjua mkewe tena, naye akamzaa mwana, akamwita jina lake Sethi, "Kwa maana Mungu ameniwekea uzao mwingine mahali pa Habili, kwa sababu Kaini alimuua."
sw.B: Adamu alikutana kimwili na mkewe tena, naye akamzaa mtoto wa kiume, akamwita Sethi, akisema, "Mungu amenipa mtoto mwingine mahali pa Habili, kwa kuwa Kaini alimuua."
sw.R: Adamu na mkewe walipata mtoto mwingine wa kiume. Mkewe alimwita Sethi. Akasema, "Mungu amenipa mtoto mwingine achukue nafasi ya Habili, kwa sababu Kaini alimuua."

vi.L: Và A-đam lại ăn ở với vợ mình, và nàng sinh một con trai và đặt tên là Sết: "Vì Đức Chúa Trời đã định cho tôi một dòng dõi khác thay cho A-bên, vì Ca-in đã giết nó."

ko.L: 그리고 아담이 다시 자기 아내를 알았다. 그러자 그 여자가 아들을 낳고 그의 이름을 셋이라고 불렀다. "가인이 아벨을 죽였으므로, 하나님께서 아벨 대신에 나에게 다른 씨를 정해 주셨다."
ko.B: 아담이 다시 아내와 동침하니, 아내가 아들을 낳고 그의 이름을 셋이라고 지으며 말했다. "가인이 아벨을 죽였으므로, 하나님께서 아벨 대신에 나에게 다른 자식을 주셨다."
ko.R: 아담과 그의 아내 사이에 또 아들이 태어났다. 아내는 그 아들의 이름을 셋이라고 지었다. 그리고 말했다. "가인이 아벨을 죽였기 때문에, 하나님께서 아벨 대신 나에게 다른 아이를 주셨다."

pt.L: E Adão conheceu de novo a sua mulher, e ela deu à luz um filho e chamou o nome dele Sete, "Porque Deus me concedeu outra descendência no lugar de Abel, já que Caim o matou."
pt.B: Adão teve relações com a sua mulher outra vez, e ela deu à luz um filho e o chamou de Sete, dizendo: "Deus me concedeu outro filho no lugar de Abel, já que Caim o matou."
pt.R: Adão e a sua esposa tiveram outro filho. Ela o chamou de Sete. Ela disse: "Deus me deu outro filho para ficar no lugar de Abel, porque Caim o matou."

am.L: አዳምም ደግሞ ሚስቱን አወቃት፤ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች፤ ስሙንም ሴት ብላ ጠራችው፤ «ቃየን ስለ ገደለው በአቤል ፋንታ እግዚአብሔር ሌላ ዘር አኖረልኝና።»

decisions.choice: Adam: here a personal name
decisions.reason: The word that meant "the man" or "humankind" is used here without the article, plainly as a name. From here on the first man is called Adam (5:1-5).

decisions.choice: Seth: a name that sounds like "appointed"
decisions.reason: Eve explains the name Seth (shet) by the verb shat, "he has appointed" or "granted".

decisions.choice: another offspring: the line continues after Abel's death
decisions.reason: The word is "seed", the word of 3:15. Through Seth the line of promise goes on, the line Genesis 5 follows to Noah.

decisions.choice: "For God has appointed for me ..."
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not say "she said"; Literal puts Eve's words in quotation marks after "For", as her reason for the name.

decisions.choice: "A-đam" from here on
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew uses Adam as a personal name (m1), so Vietnamese gives the name, in the form of 1 Corinthians 15:45 and Luke 3:38.

decisions.choice: "아담" from here on, as a personal name
decisions.reason: Until now the Hebrew has said "the man"; here the word stands without the article as a name (meaning decision m1), and Korean begins to call him 아담, as the English begins to say Adam.

decisions.choice: Adão
decisions.reason: Here the word is a personal name (m1), so Portuguese says "Adão" from this verse on, as the English says "Adam". Literal keeps "descendência", the word of 3:15, for the "seed" Eve is given (m3).

decisions.choice: "አዳም" as a name from here on; "አኖረልኝ" (he has set for me) at Literal; "እግዚአብሔር" for Elohim in Eve's words
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew word has no article and is a personal name (meaning decision m1), so Amharic says "አዳም". Seth's name sounds like the Hebrew verb "appointed" (m2); Literal says "set for me", which gives the sense, though the sound cannot be kept. Eve says Elohim, not the name, so it is "እግዚአብሔር" with no setting (see 1:1).

source.text: וּלְשֵׁ֤ת גַּם־הוּא֙ יֻלַּד־בֵּ֔ן וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ אֱנ֑וֹשׁ אָ֣ז הוּחַ֔ל לִקְרֹ֖א בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And to Seth, also to him was born a son, and he called his name Enosh. Then it was begun to call on [the] name of YHWH.

en.L: And to Seth also a son was born, and he called his name Enosh. Then [people] began to call on the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Seth also had a son, and he named him Enosh. At that time people began to call on the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Seth also had a son, and he named him Enosh. That was when people began to pray to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and worship him by name.

es.L: Y a Set, también a él le nació un hijo, y llamó su nombre Enós. Entonces se comenzó a invocar el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Set también tuvo un hijo, y lo llamó Enós. En aquel tiempo la gente comenzó a invocar el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Set también tuvo un hijo, y le puso por nombre Enós. Fue entonces cuando la gente comenzó a orar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y a adorar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.

fr.L: Et à Seth, à lui aussi, naquit un fils, et il appela son nom Énosh. Alors on commença à invoquer le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Seth eut lui aussi un fils, qu’il appela Énosh. C’est à cette époque que l’on commença à invoquer le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Seth aussi a eu un fils, et il l’a appelé Énosh. C’est à ce moment-là que les gens ont commencé à prier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et à {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}adorer en {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appelant par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.

sw.L: Naye Sethi, yeye pia, akapata mwana, akamwita jina lake Enoshi. Ndipo [watu] wakaanza kuliitia jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Sethi naye alipata mtoto wa kiume, akamwita Enoshi. Wakati huo watu walianza kuliitia jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Sethi naye alipata mtoto wa kiume, akamwita Enoshi. Wakati huo ndipo watu walipoanza kumwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumwabudu kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.

vi.L: Và Sết cũng sinh một con trai, và ông đặt tên con là Ê-nót. Bấy giờ [người ta] bắt đầu kêu cầu danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Sết cũng có một con trai, và ông đặt tên con là Ê-nót. Vào thời ấy người ta bắt đầu kêu cầu danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Sết cũng có một con trai, và ông đặt tên con là Ê-nót. Từ lúc đó người ta bắt đầu cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, gọi đúng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 셋에게도 아들이 태어나, 그가 그의 이름을 에노스라고 불렀다. 그때에 [사람들이] {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 부르기 시작하였다.
ko.B: 셋도 아들을 낳아 그의 이름을 에노스라고 지었다. 그때에 사람들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 부르기 시작하였다.
ko.R: 셋도 아들을 낳아 그의 이름을 에노스라고 지었다. 그때부터 사람들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 부르며 기도하고 예배하기 시작하였다.

pt.L: E a Sete, também a ele nasceu um filho, e ele chamou o nome dele Enos. Então [as pessoas] começaram a invocar o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Sete também teve um filho, e o chamou de Enos. Naquele tempo, as pessoas começaram a invocar o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Sete também teve um filho, e o chamou de Enos. Foi nessa época que as pessoas começaram a orar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e a adorá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} pelo nome.

am.L: ለሴትም ደግሞ ወንድ ልጅ ተወለደለት፤ ስሙንም ሄኖስ ብሎ ጠራው። በዚያን ጊዜ [ሰዎች] {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም መጥራት ጀመሩ።
am.B: ሴትም ደግሞ ወንድ ልጅ ወለደ፤ ስሙንም ሄኖስ አለው። በዚያን ጊዜ ሰዎች {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም መጥራት ጀመሩ።
am.R: ሴትም ደግሞ ወንድ ልጅ ወለደ፤ ስሙንም ሄኖስ አለው። ሰዎች {{divine_name:ወደ እግዚአብሔር|ወደ ያህዌ}} መጸለይና በስሙ ማምለክ የጀመሩት በዚያን ጊዜ ነበር።

decisions.choice: Enosh: a word for a human being
decisions.reason: Enosh is a poetic word for a human being, often stressing frailty (Psalm 8:5; 103:15).

decisions.choice: to call on the name of the LORD: to worship him and pray to him
decisions.reason: To call on the LORD's name is to worship and pray to him (12:8; Psalm 116:17). In contrast with the line of Cain, the line of Seth turns to the LORD. Exodus 6:3 says God made himself known by this name to Moses in a new way; here the narrator uses the name for the worship of the earliest people.

decisions.choice: [people] began
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "it was begun", with no subject; Literal brackets "people".

decisions.choice: pray to the LORD and worship him by name
alternatives: call on the name of the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable says what calling on the LORD's name means (m2).

decisions.choice: se comenzó a invocar
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb has no subject ("it was begun"). Spanish can say this with the impersonal "se", so Literal needs no bracketed subject, where the English Literal supplies "[people]".

decisions.choice: a orar al SEÑOR y a adorar su nombre
decisions.reason: As in English, Readable says what calling on the name means (meaning decision m2). "Adorar su nombre" lets the deity pronoun setting fall on "su"; Spanish attaches "lo" to the verb in "adorarlo", where a setting span cannot sit.

decisions.choice: Alors on commença
decisions.reason: French impersonal "on" says "it was begun" without naming anyone, as the Hebrew does, so Literal needs no bracketed subject where the English brackets "[people]".
